content.question: What is gradient descent?
options: An optimization algorithm that minimizes the loss function by iteratively adjusting the model parameters in the direction of the steepest descent of the gradient.
An algorithm that increases the loss function until the model memorizes the training data.
A technique for splitting the dataset into training and test subsets.
A method for balancing classes by resampling the training data.
content.answer: An optimization algorithm that minimizes the loss function by iteratively adjusting the model parameters in the direction of the steepest descent of the gradient.
